name: parametric-cad-design
title: Designing in Fusion
description: Use when designing or modelling in Fusion through the fusion-essentials tools - building a part or an assembly, not running a fixed procedure. Task-agnostic practice: what to settle before the first feature, how intent is carried in parameters and sketches, how an assembly's degrees of freedom are structured, and the reads that prove what you built is what you meant. Each rule states when it applies, what to do, where it does not apply, and what to read back. Guidance to apply while the design is still moving, not a checklist to recite.
summary: Aimed at the gap automated checks miss.

rules.do: state what the design must satisfy, and each interface as a checkable expectation - seating faces, aligned axes, clearance

prove.observe: the active document and its units

rules.do: hold it in a named, commented parameter and derive the rest; a buried literal freezes while geometry moves
rules.except: a measured value, in one parameter saying so; audits only read

prove.observe: each driving parameter's expression and comment

rules.do: read it back against intent, not at the end; a half-turn seating error shows in a bounding box
rules.except: a write whose result reports the effect

prove.observe: the bounding box of what was built

rules.do: prove the structure first - detail on a part sitting on the wrong plane is drawn twice
rules.except: detail that is itself the requirement

prove.observe: perpendicular, coaxial or concentric where claimed

rules.do: compare it against the acceptance you wrote, and report each item you could not meet

prove.observe: whether it reads as the object it should be

rules.do: a made part takes a functional name, a bought part its supplier number

prove.observe: the component names in the tree

rules.do: author them as configurations of one document; check the active row before calling a failed compute a defect

prove.observe: the configuration table and the active row

rules.do: draw them in one sketch so an edit carries; give independent features their own sketch; pick a profile by measured area, not index

prove.observe: each profile's area, centroid and handle

rules.when: a sketch must survive a size change
rules.do: carry symmetry, coincidence, midpoint and tangency as constraints; dimensions set only size
rules.except: a reference sketch you will not resize

prove.observe: is_fully_constrained and the constraint list

rules.do: build one and pattern it; copies answering different requirements are modelled apart
rules.except: copies that merely share a shape

prove.observe: the pattern feature in the timeline

rules.do: take terminations, draft and minimum internal radius from that process; treat edge treatment as design
rules.except: an unsettled process, which is stated rather than assumed

prove.observe: the resulting faces, their normals and radii

rules.when: an assembly has a fixed moving mechanism
rules.do: establish one intentional reference path; do not ground parts to hide missing joints

prove.observe: grounding and joint connectivity
home and representative extreme positions
overlaps at each pose

rules.when: the mechanism has a driven joint
rules.do: drive it to home and a representative extreme; keep moving joints few, the rest rigid
rules.except: a joint with no travel of interest
rules.example: a nut overlapping a plain shaft is a thread modelled as a cylinder

prove.observe: the value at each pose
overlaps at each pose, intended fit or defect

rules.do: measure each and report the number - contact where parts engage, clearance where they move
rules.except: an interface the brief left open

prove.observe: the distance or angle at each interface

rules.do: read plane normals, axis directions and containment - a flat stack passes every count while nothing nests

prove.observe: face normals and linear-edge directions

rules.when: a measurement disagrees with the brief
rules.do: report the disagreement - a measurement is evidence about the artifact; intent comes from the brief
rules.except: a brief quoting a measured fact about existing hardware

prove.observe: the measured value beside the brief's

rules.do: confirm the effect through a read other than the tool's claim; read a refusal's reason before retrying
rules.except: a deferred write, confirmed through the poller it names

prove.observe: the timeline entry the write claims

rules.do: leave the saved state valid, look at the result, and say what you could not do

prove.observe: the document's save state
